sloka: भज प्रीतिं प्रहर्षं च त्यजैतां नित्यदैन्यताम् ।सीते राक्षसराजेन सह क्रीड यथासुखम् ।। ५.२२.२८।।।।
transliteration: bhaja prītiṁ praharṣaṁ ca tyajaitāṁ nityadainyatām ।sīte rākṣasarājena saha krīḍa yathāsukham ।। 5.22.28।।।।

translations.english: He stood like a mountain with two Ashoka trees clothed with red leaves and flowers in the form of earrings of the colour of the rising Sun.
